meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把脚本和素材编排成多场景视频或品牌宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把素材拼成一段完整的多场景视频作品
copy.tagline_en: Turn scripts and footage into multi-scene videos or brand reels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assemble footage into a full multi-scene video piece

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 BRIEF.md 编写或修改 HyperFrames 视频合成:先规划分镜、写 STORYBOARD.md,再产出多场景片、品牌/宣传集锦、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡和素材重剪等。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流匹配,或 BRIEF.md 标注 flow: companion 时接管;全新创作需先经 /hyperframes 路由,输入含 figma.com 链接会先跑 /figma。

say.text: 帮我做一个 30 秒的多场景品牌宣传片,分镜写进 BRIEF.md
say.note: 它会先规划场景结构与节奏,再写脚本和分镜

say.text: 把这段素材重剪成三段蒙太奇,加一张标题卡
say.note: 复制同一视频源成多个片段,各自设定起止和顺序

say.text: 做一个带音乐的静态循环背景片
say.note: 生成静态循环合成并配上音乐

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors or edits a HyperFrames video composition: it reads BRIEF.md, plans scenes, writes STORYBOARD.md, and builds multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes.
howto.when_en: Takes over when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion; fresh creation must route through /hyperframes first. A figma.com input runs /figma first.

say_en.text: Make a 30s multi-scene brand sizzle reel; storyboard into BRIEF.md.
say_en.note: It plans structure, rhythm, then writes script and storyboard.

say_en.text: Remix this footage into a three-part montage and add a title card.
say_en.note: It duplicates the source into clips with set ranges and order.

say_en.text: Build a static loop background clip with music.
say_en.note: It generates a static loop composition with audio.
